method.fold_assignment: sha256('t8-vote-cv-v1:' + group) interpreted as an integer modulo 5
method.training_selection: for each candidate independently, use it on the held-out fold only when its complementary training-fold accuracy exceeds the unfiltered reference; exact tie selects the reference

fixed_candidate_out_of_fold.note: fixed preregistered predictions are unchanged by fold; the aggregate fixed OOF result is therefore byte-identical to in-sample
